tool_schemas.name: search_gifs
tool_schemas.description: Searches Giphy for GIFs matching q for the given workspace, using the workspace’s default credential unless credential_id is provided, and returns up to limit results starting at offset (offset-based pagination), optionally serving a fresh cached response when use_cache is true and persisting the request/response for audit and analytics. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/credential_id formats are invalid, q is empty, limit is not 1–50, offset is negative, or cache_ttl_seconds is provided but < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or the specified credential_id does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the credential does not belong to the workspace, UNAUTHORIZED if no usable credential is available for the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when workspace/credential usage quotas are exceeded (including when forwarding a request to Giphy).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id used to resolve configuration, caching, and usage tracking.

credential_id.description: API credential id to use for the Giphy request (must belong to the workspace).

limit.description: Maximum number of GIFs to return.

lang.description: Language for regional content; defaults from workspace configuration when omitted.

rating.description: Content rating filter to apply to results.

use_cache.description: Whether to serve a cached response when available.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a newly stored response should be considered fresh for caching.

tool_schemas.name: get_random_gif
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single random GIF from Giphy for the given workspace, optionally filtered by tag and further constrained by rating/lang (defaulting lang from workspace configuration when omitted), optionally serving a fresh cached response when use_cache is true and persisting the request/response for audit and analytics. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/credential_id formats are invalid or cache_ttl_seconds is provided but < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or the specified credential_id does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the credential does not belong to the workspace, UNAUTHORIZED if no usable credential is available for the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when workspace/credential usage quotas are exceeded (including when forwarding a request to Giphy).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id used to resolve configuration, caching, and usage tracking.

credential_id.description: API credential id to use for the Giphy request (must belong to the workspace).

tag.description: Optional tag to filter the random GIF selection.

rating.description: Content rating filter to apply to the random GIF selection.

lang.description: Language for regional content; defaults from workspace configuration when omitted.

use_cache.description: Whether to serve a cached response when available.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a newly stored response should be considered fresh for caching.

tool_schemas.name: get_trending_gifs
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves currently trending GIFs from Giphy for the given workspace and returns up to limit results starting at offset (offset-based pagination), optionally applying rating/bundle and serving a fresh cached response when use_cache is true while persisting the request/response for audit and analytics. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/credential_id formats are invalid, limit is not 1–50, offset is negative, or cache_ttl_seconds is provided but < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or the specified credential_id does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the credential does not belong to the workspace, UNAUTHORIZED if no usable credential is available for the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when workspace/credential usage quotas are exceeded (including when forwarding a request to Giphy).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id used to resolve configuration, caching, and usage tracking.

credential_id.description: API credential id to use for the Giphy request (must belong to the workspace).

limit.description: Maximum number of trending GIFs to return.

rating.description: Content rating filter to apply to trending results.

use_cache.description: Whether to serve a cached response when available.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a newly stored response should be considered fresh for caching.

tool_schemas.name: create_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new workspace used to scope credentials, caching, and usage tracking, and returns the created workspace record. Refuses invalid fields and does not allow creating a workspace in status "deleted".

default_language.description: Default language code (used when lang is omitted on GIF tools).

default_region.description: Default region code (used for regional content defaults).

tool_schemas.name: update_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable workspace fields and/or transitions its status. Returns the updated workspace. Refuses transitions not allowed by the lifecycle (active↔suspended, active/suspended→deleted) and refuses updates once status is "deleted".

status.description: New workspace status (must be a valid lifecycle transition).

tool_schemas.name: create_api_credential
tool_schemas.description: Stores a Giphy API key for a workspace and returns the created credential metadata (never returns the raw key). Refuses creation when the workspace is deleted and refuses unsupported providers.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that will own this credential.

api_key.description: Giphy API key to encrypt and store (not returned once stored).

status.description: Initial credential status; defaults to active when omitted.

tool_schemas.name: update_api_credential
tool_schemas.description: Updates an API credential’s status and/or rotates its key. Returns the updated credential metadata. Refuses lifecycle-invalid transitions (active↔disabled, active/disabled→revoked), refuses updates once revoked, and refuses operations when the credential does not belong to the given workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that must own the credential.

status.description: New credential status (must be a valid lifecycle transition).

api_key.description: New Giphy API key to rotate to (stored encrypted; not returned).

tool_schemas.name: list_gif_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted GIF request records for a workspace for auditing/analytics with filtering and offset-based pagination. Returns request rows and does not include raw upstream response bodies.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to list requests for.

tool_name.description: Filter by tool that produced the request.

created_from.description: Only include requests created at or after this timestamp.

created_to.description: Only include requests created before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

metadata.name: Giphy API Integration
metadata.description: This backend powers an integration layer over the Giphy API, storing tenant/workspace configuration (API keys), executing GIF fetch operations (search/random/trending), and persisting responses for auditing, caching, and analytics. Primary workflows are: configure access credentials, issue a request
